notes: 1984 parliament minutes in a worn, light monotonic typeface (hence the low Google confidence); the random lines 1-20 and the headings read correctly despite the faint print. The many 'ΠΡΟΕΔΡΕΥΩΝ (Μάρκος Ι. Νάτσινας). Συνεπώς, το' lines are genuine repeated chair interjections, each crop matching its label. Isolated faults only: doubled words in 23 ('δους, δους. οικοδομικές οικοδομικές') and an appended fragment in 32, one gutter join (21), and Cyrillic 'О/Г' for Greek 'Ο/Γ' in 38 - at most a handful of 1438 lines.
